title: CLAUDE.md — alepe
text: R package wrapping open data API Legislative Assembly Pernambuco (https://dadosabertos.alepe.pe.gov.br). Target: CRAN, pkgdown site. Part André’s suite Brazilian public-data packages (tcepe, comex, ibger) sharing httr2/cli/tidyverse style.

title: CLAUDE.md — alepe
text: Owner: André (leite@castlab.org), CASTLab/UFPE. Communicates Brazilian Portuguese; package code, docs, vignettes, commit messages English. Broad delegation: implement without asking, except (1) exported API surface changes (function names/signatures), (2) naming, (3) architectural divergence current design. Pause ask three. Every non-obvious choice gets entry DECISIONS.md (D1–D10 far; continue numbering). Small, descriptive commits — one logical change . See git log established style. Visual changes (pkgdown theme, logo, README figures): show preview finalizing.

title: CLAUDE.md — alepe
text: One exported function per endpoint, prefix alepe_, always returns tibble. also Portuguese alias named endpoint (alepe_servidores(), alepe_licitacoes()); new endpoint needs alias R/aliases.R row table (D19). Graceful failure contract (CRAN internet policy): fetch layer returns NULL classed cli_warn() (alepe_error_http, alepe_error_parse); endpoint layer converts NULL zero-row tibble documented schema (propositions: zero-column tibble — see D5). Never stop() network problems. R CMD check must never touch network. Retry 429/500/502/503/504, max_tries = 3, backoff 2^(D6). Cache via httr2::req_cache() tools::R_user_dir("alepe", "cache"), 6 h default, refresh = TRUE per call (D7). Options: alepe.quiet, alepe.cache_dir, alepe.cache_max_age, alepe.max_tries, alepe.timeout. Column names: official Portuguese fields normalized snake_case, never translated (D2). Filter values: English first, Portuguese accepted (D3) — see map_status(). clean_names() uses explicit chartr transliteration: tolower() iconv(//TRANSLIT) locale-dependent break C locale CRAN check machines. “simplify” back. Dependencies deliberately minimal: httr2, cli, rlang, tibble, readr (D8). add xml2 (D4). jsonlite arrives via httr2 declared Suggests tests call directly — R CMD check warns otherwise.
code: R/req.R          alepe_req() -> alepe_perform() -> alepe_fetch_json()/csv() R/utils.R        clean_names(), records_to_tibble(schema), map_status() R/cache.R        alepe_cache_dir(), alepe_cache_clear() R/people.R       representatives, staff, positions, departments, remuneration R/money.R        contracts, procurements R/propositions.R bills, indications, requests (CSV path) R/aliases.R      Portuguese aliases (alepe_servidores(), ...) (D19)

title: CLAUDE.md — alepe
text: Base: https://dadosabertos.alepe.pe.gov.br/api/v1/<endpoint>/; formats JSON/CSV, except /proposicoes/{projetos,indicacoes, requerimentos} serve XML/CSV — use CSV . Propositions CSV XML inside single CSV column: one fragment per row listing mode, one full document detail mode. Parsed regex R/propositions.R (D13); free text HTML-encoded (double-encoded indicacoes) goes strip_html(). Propositions: detail mode needs numero + ano together (validated client-side, alepe_error_input); listing mode filters ano /legislatura; filter = current year (API default). vinculo values: efetivo, comissionado, -disposicao. Field names come two conventions: ALL_CAPS underscores (/servidores) camelCase (nomeParlamentar, vigenciaInicio); clean_names() handles . Numbers come two encodings: "1.234,56" float-formatted strings ("119267.04", "2026.00"). parse_br_number() decides per value — never swap fixed-locale readr::parse_number() (D12). Dates arrive either dd/mm/yyyy strings serialized DateTime objects ({"date": "...", "timezone": ...}), unwrapped records_to_tibble(). /proposicoes listing CSVs end blank row; parser drops rows without docid. /lotacoes fixed reference period baked API excludes retired staff. /licitacoes flaky: alternates fast 200s server-side 30 s timeout returning HTTP 500. exactly retry--graceful-failure path (500 transient list), outage costs user ~90 s empty tibble, error. Don’t “fix” dropping 500 retry list. site’s robots.txt blocks generic crawlers; package’s descriptive user agent set alepe_req() — keep . API blocks GitHub-hosted runners entirely (http=000, zero bytes, curl 28 90 s, probed 2026-08-13 Azure eastus). Anything built Actions sees empty API, pkgdown site published locally deploy_to_branch() workflow manual-(D20). CI green therefore says nothing live-data behaviour.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: Short, lowercase, matches institution’s acronym, consistent tcepe sibling package. CRAN conflict time writing. Alternatives considered: alepepe, alepedata.

what: D2. Column names: normalized, not translated
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: API fields (NOME_LOTACAO, CARGO_NIVEL) lowercased snake_case kept Portuguese. Rationale: traceability official source Assembly’s documentation; pattern followed Brazilian public-data packages CRAN (geobr, microdatasus). Function names, arguments, docs English.

what: D3. Filter vocabulary: English first, Portuguese accepted
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: status = "permanent" | "commissioned" | "seconded" maps internally vinculo=efetivo|comissionado|-disposicao. original API terms also accepted via extended arg_match(). Rationale: English-language package force users guess Portuguese API constants, Brazilian users copy-pasting official docs punished either.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: propositions endpoints serve XML CSV (unlike rest API, serves JSON CSV). request CSV parse readr, avoiding xml2 dependency second parsing code path. Trade-: API’s detail mode ever nests structures expressible XML, needs revisiting.

what: D5. Graceful failure returns typed empty tibbles, not NULL
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: CRAN policy requires internet resources fail gracefully informative message. Endpoint functions warn (classes alepe_error_http / alepe_error_parse) return zero-row tibble documented schema, NULL. Rationale: downstream dplyr pipelines survive; schema contract holds even offline. internal fetch layer return NULL, endpoint layer converts. Exception: propositions return tibble::tibble() (zero columns) failure, schema defined API response, package.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = 2^) 429/500/502/503/504 . 4xx client errors retried (fix ). Configurable via options(alepe.max_tries = ).

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: httr2::req_cache() tools::R_user_dir("alepe", "cache") (CRAN-compliant location), 6 h default expiry, per-call bypass refresh = TRUE, global controls via options, alepe_cache_clear() exported. Rationale 6 h: underlying datasets update daily; 6 h balances freshness API load.

what: D8. readr as a hard dependency
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: Used CSV parsing (propositions) locale-aware number parsing (1.234,56 → 1234.56). Considered utils::read.csv + hand-rolled parsing save dependency; rejected — readr ubiquitous target audience’s stack locale handling removes class bugs.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: Messages via cli, default interactive sessions; options(alepe.quiet = TRUE/FALSE) overrides. messages ever affect return values.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: Unit tests mock fetch layer use JSON fixtures reconstructed official documentation examples. Real-traffic fixtures recorded httptest2 (instructions tests/testthat/test-endpoints.R) first CRAN submission. R CMD check never touches network.

what: D11. Fixtures are verbatim samples of real payloads (2026-08-12)
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: guessed fixtures replaced first records real endpoint response, captured curl 2026-08-12. local_mocked_bindings() pattern kept instead migrating httptest2::with_mock_dir(): mocking fetch layer exercises parsing code less machinery, graceful-failure tests already cover layer . httptest2 stays Suggests future recording sessions. Refresh instructions live header tests/testthat/test-endpoints.R.

what: D12. Number parsing is heuristic, not locale-based
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: Observed payloads mix two numeric encodings: Brazilian comma-decimal strings ("1.234,56", propositions ementas) plain float-formatted strings ("119267.04", "2026.00" — contracts, procurements, remuneration). fixed readr locale corrupts one (BRL locale reads "119267.04" 11 926 704). parse_br_number() decides per value: comma always decimal mark; without comma, dots group marks form pure 3-digit groups. Integer years process numbers arrive float-formatted ("2026.00") rounded integer.

what: D13. Propositions XML-in-CSV parsed with regex, still no xml2
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: propositions CSV single column carrying one XML fragment per row (listing) one XML document (detail). Rather adding xml2 (D4) returning raw XML strings, fragments parsed regular expressions — flat, machine-generated, attribute-quoted, usual “don’t parse XML regex” hazards apply. Listing returns docid/numero/ano/legislatura/tipo/subtipo/ ementa/data_publicacao plus autores (collapsed ;-separated author names); detail returns scalar elements (materia, justificativa, regime, resultado, etc.). HTML markup entities free-text fields stripped/decoded (strip_html()), including double-encoded ementas indicacoes. materiaHtml/justificativaHtml historico event log deliberately returned.

what: D14. Schemas corrected against observed payloads (2026-08-12)
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: Documentation-guessed schemas wrong places; observed truth: /parlamentares nomeParlamentar + partido (email); /servidores SEQ/SITUACAO CARGO_EFETIVO DATA_ADMISSAO (serialized PHP DateTime object — handled records_to_tibble()); /remuneracao includes tipoCargo, mesCompetencia, anoCompetencia; /contratos uses contratada, numeroContrato, vigenciaInicio/Fim links procurement via numeroLicitacao/anoLicitacao (note: API currently publishes numeroContrato mirroring cpfCnpj); /licitacoes uses status, valorEstimado, valorAdjudicado, vencedor (latter three null undecided processes). camelCase field names split snake_case clean_names(). Identifier strings (cpfCnpj) kept exactly published, float-formatting artifacts included.

what: D15. Default timeout raised from 30 s to 60 s (2026-08-13)
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: /licitacoes regularly answers ~28 s , server load, spends 30 s returns HTTP 500. 30 s client timeout endpoint failed intermittently reason margin thin. 60 s keeps well clear still bounding hung request. Retry policy unchanged: 500 stays transient list (D6), genuine server error still costs three attempts graceful-failure path.

what: D16. Vignette charts are guarded against an empty API response
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: first published site showed blank charts: pkgdown build ran API outage, endpoints returned zero-row tibbles exactly designed, ggplot2 dutifully drew empty panels. blank chart reads broken package, worse chart. Every chart chunk now carries eval = have_rows(x), companion chunk emits short note data missing. guard lives vignettes, package: graceful-failure contract unchanged.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: man/figures/logo.svg, request-flow.svg architecture.svg hand-written SVG rather generated bitmaps: stay sharp size, cost KB, can diffed edited text editor. Colours explicit (currentColor) every diagram paints light background, reads site’s light dark modes. diagrams carry /<desc> README <img> tags carry long alt text describing flow words.

title: Design decisions — alepe
text: site follows tidyverse look via template: package: tidytemplate. tidytemplate CRAN, declared Config/Needs/website (tidyverse/tidytemplate) r-lib setup action can install GitHub; website-dependency never affects R CMD check installation.

what: D19. Portuguese aliases for every endpoint function
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: exported surface English (D2/D3 keep column names Portuguese filter values bilingual), audience Brazilian API’s vocabulary Portuguese. endpoint function now alias named endpoint wraps — alepe_servidores() alepe_staff(), alepe_licitacoes() alepe_procurements() — pipeline can stay one language end end. real wrapper functions, f <- g assignments: gives correct \usage sections, keeps argument documentation attached, makes error messages point function user actually called. propositions aliases also translate argument names (numero/ano/legislatura), spell signature instead forwarding .... Names carry accents: accented identifiers legal R awkward type fragile across locales — reasoning drives chartr transliteration clean_names().

what: D20. The site is published from a machine that can reach the API
title: Design decisions — alepe
text: ALEPE API refuses connections GitHub-hosted runners. probe job ubuntu-latest (Azure eastus) got http=000, zero bytes curl exit 28 /contratos, /servidores /licitacoes 90 s , requests answer second laptop Brazil. Presumably WAF geo rule datacenter ranges — consistent robots.txt blocks generic crawlers. Consequences, order importance: Vignettes built GitHub Actions contain data. produced blank charts first published site, D16 guards now turn honest note. pkgdown.yaml workflow_dispatch , site published pkgdown::deploy_to_branch() machine can reach API. Otherwise next push silently replace good site data-less one. R CMD check CI unaffected — passes either way, graceful-failure contract turns outage zero-row tibbles rather errors. Worth remembering CI therefore proves nothing live-data behaviour; local check fixtures .

text: alepe.quiet: suppress informational messages. Defaults TRUE non-interactive sessions. alepe.cache_dir: cache location. Defaults tools::R_user_dir("alepe", "cache"). alepe.cache_max_age: cache expiry seconds. Defaults 6 hours. alepe.max_tries: maximum request attempts. Defaults 3, exponential backoff attempts. alepe.timeout: request timeout seconds. Defaults 60; slowest endpoint (/licitacoes) regularly needs close 30 s.

title: alepe 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Tidy wrappers documented v1 endpoints ALEPE open data API: representatives, staff, positions, departments, remuneration, contracts, procurements, legislative propositions (bills, indications, requests). Local response cache, exponential-backoff retries, graceful failures compliant CRAN policy internet resources. Every endpoint function Portuguese alias named API endpoint wraps (alepe_servidores(), alepe_contratos(), alepe_projetos(), …); see ?alepe_aliases.
